metadata.question: During the year of 2018, did Washington D.C. experience at least 50 inches of rainfall?

data.raw_code: The question asks if Washington D.C. experienced at least 50 inches of rainfall during 2018. This requires precipitation data. Strategy: 1. Use precipitation datasets - CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) is a good choice for rainfall data 2. Location: Washington D.C. area (I'll use a point buffer around the center) 3. Time: Year 2018 4. Unit conversion: CHIRPS provides mm, so need to convert to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm) 5. Need to sum daily/monthly precipitation for the entire year For CHIRPS, I'll use the daily collection 'UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY' which has 'precipitation' band in mm. Logic: - Sum all precipitation for 2018 - Convert from mm to inches - Check if >= 50 inches Need to handle: - Empty collection (try monthly if daily fails) - Valid pixels check - Unit conversion validation ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const dcGeometry = ee.Geometry.Point([-77.0369, 38.9072]).buffer(10000); // Washington D.C. center with 10km buffer const startDate = '2018-01-01'; const endDate = '2019-01-01'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Try CHIRPS daily precipitation first let precipCol = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(dcGeometry); let colSize = precipCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`CHIRPS Daily Images: ${colSize}`); // 3. Check for empty collection if (colSize === 0) { // Try monthly CHIRPS as fallback precipCol = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/MONTHLY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(dcGeometry); colSize = precipCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`CHIRPS Monthly Images: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } } // 4. Calculate total precipitation for the year const totalPrecip = precipCol.sum(); // 5. Check valid pixels const pixelCount = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: dcGeometry, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid Pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 6. Calculate mean precipitation and convert to inches const meanPrecip = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: dcGeometry, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); // Convert mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm) const precipInches = meanPrecip / 25.4; console.log(`Annual Precipitation: ${precipInches.toFixed(2)} inches`); // 7. Validation & Final Answer if (precipInches === null || precipInches === undefined || isNaN(precipInches)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (precipInches < 0 || precipInches > 200) { // Unreasonable range check console.log("C3"); } else if (precipInches >= 50) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
